Since $\Delta M_f(0)=0$, the two branches of §6.8 coincide, $K_\pm=\tau I$, and the constrained birth equation $\tau d_\perp+S_f=0$, $|d_\perp|^2=\Delta_3$, has exactly the two antipodal solutions $d_\perp=\mp\sqrt{\Delta_3}\,S_f/|S_f|$, with $\tau=\pm|S_f|/\sqrt{\Delta_3}$; for $\Delta_3=0$ it has none.
